Dear Customer,

As part of our continuous security operations, we are deploying a mandatory security patch on our Public Cloud services (VPS and instances).

This action is preventive and controlled. The patch has already been tested, and our teams are overseeing the deployment progressively across our infrastructure.

There will be a service interruption lasting less than 30 minutes during the intervention affecting the concerned Public Cloud Instances and VPS.

Important information:
  • 2 Virtual machines within the same PCI project that would be hosted on different physical hypervisors will not be restarted at the same time.
  • All Public Cloud API will remain available during the operation.
We remain committed to maintaining a secure, reliable, and transparent infrastructure for our customers.

Best regards,
The OVHcloud Team
